{{Quote|She was subdued by the clones and found in possession of explosive nano-droids.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] reports Tano's capture|<ref name="TCAJ" />}}
While on the run in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was '''captured''' by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].<ref name="TCAJ" />

==Prelude==
{{Quote|She's in the lower depths. With her skills, she will be hard to find.''"<br />"''Two teams we will send: Master Skywalker and Master Plo Koon. With clones, you will go.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] assign search parties for Tano|<ref name="TCAJ" />}}
[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], accused of masterminding the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|hangar]] and murdering [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escaped]] from the [[Republic military base]] where she was being held and fled into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After fleeing from several [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] officers, Tano was attacked by former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] who wanted to bring Tano in for the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head. Tano managed to convince Ventress to help her by pointing out the bounty hunter's [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|own betrayal]] and the two formed a partnership to find information that would clear Tano's name.<ref name="TCAJ" />

Meanwhile, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] held a meeting to discuss how best to deal with finding Tano. Almost all of the council believed her to be guilty and they chose [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to find her. With a squadron of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], they descended to the lower levels.<ref name="TCAJ" />

==The capture==
{{Quote|We're taking you in now, Commander.''"<br />"''That's not gonna happen. Trust me.|Wolffe and Ahsoka Tano, before Tano escapes from him|<ref name="TCAJ" />}}
[[File:WolffeStunsAhsoka.png|thumb|left|200px|Wolffe stuns Tano after finding her in a Level 1315 warehouse.]]
As Anakin Skywalker's and Plo Koon's [[Republic police gunship/Legends|police gunships]] approached [[Terminal 24/Legends|terminal 24]] to land, Skywalker saw Tano and Ventress together on the platform. The pair escaped, and Skywalker sent several [[Unidentified probe droid|probe droids]] to find them.

Tano contacted [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], who told her about a [[Abandoned munitions warehouse/Legends|warehouse]] on [[Level 1315/Legends|level 1315]], that Turmond had visited prior to bombing the Temple. However, before Ventress and Tano could go to the warehouse, they were seen by one of the probe droids and confronted by Commander [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]]. The two quickly subdued Wolffe's patrol and headed to the warehouse.<ref name="TCAJ" />

There, the two parted ways and Tano headed into the warehouse. However, Ventress was attacked by Offee, who stole [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsabers]] and her helmet, and then proceeded to the warehouse Tano was searching. Offee attacked Tano, slowly leading her up and through the building. Sparking barrels filled with explosive gas, Offee caused an explosion that alerted the pursuing Jedi and severely dazed Tano. Struggling to stay on her feet, Tano was disarmed by Offee and kicked through the floor, landing amongst crates of [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]]. Offee fled just as Wolffe and the clones arrived. Wolffe quickly stunned the unarmed Tano and she was taken back to the Jedi Temple.<ref name="TCAJ" /><ref name="TWJ" />

==Aftermath==
Having captured Tano, the Jedi acknowledged the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate's]] wish for a military trial and expelled Tano from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. They turned her over to the military where she was prosecuted in the [[High Court]].<ref name="TWJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The capture of Ahsoka Tano was first shown in The Clone Wars episode "To Catch a Jedi." While the duel between Ahsoka and Barriss was first shown in that episode, it was only revealed to be Barriss later, in the episode "The Wrong Jedi."
